description: This file defines the interface for a wrapper around libcurl multi interface, including an implementation class and static methods for managing curl multi operations.

classes.name: CurlWrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract class providing virtual methods for curl multi operations, to be implemented for specific behaviors.

classes.name: CurlWraps
classes.description: A class providing static methods to perform curl multi operations, managing an internal implementation instance.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::~CurlWrapsImpl
methods.description: Virtual destructor for cleanup in derived classes.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::curl_multi_perform
methods.description: Performs the curl multi perform operation.

methods.name: CurlWraps::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance used by CurlWraps.

methods.name: CurlWraps::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of CurlWraps.
